title: Chico Crypto collaboration funding
body:
## ![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/3e90387b-e6c8-4444-bed9-f1925b46568c.1623342094127)

## **UPDATE: 17.06.21**

- We've agreed with Tyler and Greg to use the Exit Theory podcast as a rough proposal template since it has some similarities and is an ongoing commitment spread over a series of months which makes it more cost effective for Edgeware and also means we can have a tighter strategic alignment as they moves toward the launch of Blockchain Leaks and we help lay the foundations for a MediaDAO.

> _**This is something we would love to imitate, and work off of.  Although, our scope I think will be much bigger - Chico Crypto.**_
- View the [Exit Theory proposal here](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1131-exit-theory-a-content-and-community-project)


**UPDATE: 10.06.21**

- We (myself and[ @Shankar Warang](/edgeware/account/jA7pLH65zgRNA4UgwqHEWWRxTgg51wuAUgfzmZoYWM2dMVS)) had a call with Chico (Tyler) and his manager Greg this morning and discussed Edgeware, where he's moving with Chico Crypto and how we can collaborate.


- We agreed that going forward all discussions can be public so the community can see the process and also contribute ideas - these are the key points from the discussion.


- Chico is a fan of Edgeware and the community, it was the first project he followed as the first smart contract chain in Substrate/Polkadot. He hasn't kept up to date but he's excited about ways to collaborate going forward.


- He is open to discussing the project through an update video that can include a range of things, but this would be something we would collaborate on and would cover a range of topics including smart contracts, community treasury, projects in development and research areas such as parachains / chain bridges (which are in the research phase)
